Scene Setup, Assets & Runtime

Modules: superdex.physics.paths, superdex.physics.environment, superdex.physics.loader, superdex.physics.utils.context, superdex.physics.utils.scene_helpers

Find assets, select the runtime, and build a scene in one call.

superdex.physics.paths

get_assets_root() → Path[source]
resolve_asset(path: str | Path) → Path[source]

Resolves an asset to an absolute path. Absolute paths are returned as they are.

resolve_asset_root(path: str | Path) → Path[source]

Returns the assets root that path resolves under.

A prefab carries paths relative to the root it was authored against, so loading one needs the root it came from rather than the directory it happens to sit in.

superdex.physics.environment

ASSETS_PATH_ENV_VAR

Environment variable used to specify the location of the assets directory.

DEBUGGER_PATH_ENV_VAR

Environment variable used to specify the mochi_debugger executable path.

LEGACY_ASSETS_PATH_ENV_VAR

Deprecated environment variable alias for the assets directory.

LEGACY_DEBUGGER_PATH_ENV_VAR

Deprecated environment variable alias for the debugger executable path.

LEGACY_LOG_LEVEL_ENV_VAR

Deprecated environment variable alias for the Python logging level.

LEGACY_PRECISION_ENV_VAR

Deprecated environment variable alias for bindings precision.

LOG_LEVEL_ENV_VAR

Environment variable used to specify the Python logging level (DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL).

PRECISION_ENV_VAR

Environment variable used to select SuperDex bindings precision (single, double).

get_env_var_value(primary: str, legacy: str) → str | None[source]

Return a canonical env value, falling back to the deprecated alias.

Membership rather than truthiness: an empty canonical value is how a caller clears an inherited setting, so it has to win over the legacy alias instead of reading as unset.

set_env_var_value(primary: str, legacy: str, value: str) → None[source]

Write the canonical env value, mirroring to the deprecated alias only if in use.

Mirroring unconditionally would introduce the deprecated name into a process that never had it and then leak it to every child, so a clean environment stays clean.

superdex.physics.loader

PRECISION_NAME: str

The selected precision name.

USE_DOUBLE_PRECISION

Whether to use the double precision variants for SuperDex Physics bindings.

superdex.physics.utils.context

Context managers for SuperDex Physics engine lifecycle.

class MochiContext(num_worker_threads: int = -1, logger: Logger | None = None)[source]

Bases: object

Context manager for SuperDex Physics engine initialization and cleanup.

This context manager ensures that the SuperDex Physics engine is properly initialized before use and cleanly shut down afterwards, preventing resource leaks and ensuring proper cleanup of the simulation environment.

Parameters:

num_worker_threads – Number of worker threads for parallel simulation. Defaults to -1, which lets SuperDex Physics auto-detect the optimal number based on available CPU cores.

Example

>>> with MochiContext():
...     scene = mochi.create_scene("")
...     # Perform simulation operations...
>>> # SuperDex Physics is automatically shut down here

Note

All SuperDex Physics scene creation and simulation operations must be performed within this context. Attempting to use SuperDex Physics outside of this context will result in undefined behavior.

superdex.physics.utils.scene_helpers

A collection of helper functions for SuperDex Physics scene manipulation.

create_ground_plane(scene: Scene, normal: Real3 | None = None, offset: float = 0.0, contact_params: ContactParams | None = None) → Actor[source]

Creates a ground plane actor in the scene. By default, the plane is initialized pointing at +Y, and an offset of 0. If you want a different plane, you can specify the normal and offset. Unless you specify contact parameters, the default values will be used.

create_scene_from_prefab(prefab: str | ScenePrefab, root_dir: str | Path | None = None, params: PrefabParams | None = None, scene_name: str = '') → Scene[source]

Create a SuperDex Physics scene and initialize it using a ScenePrefab object or prefab file path.

Parameters:

  • prefab – Either a file path to a prefab file (e.g., “samples/my_scene.mochi_scene”) or a ScenePrefab object. Referenced model files and nested prefabs will be loaded as necessary. Relative file paths will be resolved using the specified root_dir.

  • root_dir – The root directory for resolving relative paths. None (default) or an empty string selects the assets directory (SUPERDEX_ASSETS_PATH environment variable). A pathlib.Path is always taken literally, including Path(""), which pathlib normalizes to Path("."). Used for resolving the prefab file path (when prefab is a str) and for loading any nested prefabs and shape files referenced within the prefab.

  • params – Optional PrefabParams to customize prefab loading. If None, default parameters are used.

  • scene_name – Optional name for the created scene. If empty, the scene will have no name.

Returns:

The created SuperDex Physics scene with the prefab loaded into it.

Example

import superdex.physics as mochi
from superdex.physics.utils.scene_helpers import create_scene_from_prefab

# Example 1: Load prefab from file with relative path
scene = create_scene_from_prefab("samples/my_scene.mochi_scene")

# Example 2: Load, modify, then create scene
p = mochi.prefab.shallow_load_from_file("samples/my_scene.mochi_scene")
p.scene.gravity = [0.0, -5.0, 0.0]
scene = create_scene_from_prefab(p, root_dir="/custom/path/to/assets")
find_actor(scene: Scene, pattern: str) → Actor[source]

Returns an actor whose name matches the given pattern. The pattern is specified as a case-sensitive string that may contain shell-style wildcards, such as * and ?. For example, “my_actor*” will match any actor whose name starts with “my_actor”. If no actor matches the pattern, or there are multiple candidate actors, an error is raised.
